newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork to close plants, cut 560 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork to close plants, cut 560 jobs.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co. Inc., a maker of bottle caps and metal cans, said Tuesday it will close six factories, eliminating 560 jobs.
Crown said the plants slated for closure belong to its Constar subsidiary and that the move was aimed at improving its plastic beverage container business.
The Philadelphia-based company said it will take an after-tax charge of about $43 million, or 31 cents a share, to account for the costs associated with the closings.
The charge also covers other restructuring activities, primarily in Europe, the company said.

"Annual savings relating to all of these actions, when fully implemented, are expected to be approximately $20 million, or 14 cents per share on a fully diluted basis," the packaging products company said.
Crown made the announcement after the close of stock trading. Its shares closed at $52.50, up 56 cents, in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
